card.title: The Ritual Explains Itself Later
card.instruction: Treat one unexplained recurring action as essential. Allow its meaning to change each time it returns.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before your audition, knock twice on this door. We can't skip that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They knocked back. Can we go in? My hands are shaking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twice again. Now we're saying we're ready, even if your hands aren't.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're calling me in alone. How will I know you're still here?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll knock twice when your song ends. This time it means I'm staying until you come out.

mechanism: A insists on two knocks, then uses the recurring signal to mean readiness and staying with the auditioning person.
confusable: Unlike simple reassurance, the repeated action itself must carry the changing meanings.
comparison: S235-b gives a signal across an audition door; S235-a makes a tea-table ritual hold space for an absent voice.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
